def ballpos(fr, col):
    for i,row in enumerate(fr.ascii.split('\n')):
        for j,c in enumerate(row):
            if c==col: return (i,j)
    return None
def balls(fr):
    return ('Y',ballpos(fr,'Y')),('N',ballpos(fr,'N'))
